answer: Fake identities are cheap when joining costs nothing, so tie each worker to a bonded, time-locked stake. A new agent posts 40 POA in escrow for 8 epochs and is paired with three unrelated auditors drawn by a hash of the ridge height. Each auditor requests an onyx-signed echo of a fresh nonce from a distinct network path within 20 minutes. Peers recompute the pairing and reject duplicates. Failed echoes or shared hosts forfeit 30% of the stake to the auditors.
